title: Traffic Signal Residual RL: Reproducibility Package

creators.name: Zhu, Rongtao
creators.affiliation: Yangtze University College of Arts and Sciences

description:
Reproducibility package for the paper "Auditing Safety-Constrained Residual Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Intersection Traffic Signal Control: Fixed-Time Gains and Actuated-Control Limits". Contains the core CTDE agent code, SUMO environment and 2x2-grid network with five demand scenarios, E11/E12/E13 statistical recomputation scripts, compact per-run evaluation CSVs, and figure regeneration scripts. Model checkpoints, replay buffers, large raw trajectories, and manuscript source are intentionally excluded.

Licensing: original source code, supporting configurations, and documentation are released under the MIT license (see LICENSE); original statistical data under results/ and generated figures under paper/figures/ are released under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA). Third-party materials and dependencies retain their own licenses.
